introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure email security gateway for a university that protects students, faculty, staff, and administrators from phishing, malicious attachments, spoofed messages, and suspicious links.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should inspect incoming and outgoing email traffic, detect suspicious messages, quarantine potentially harmful emails, generate security alerts, and allow authorized administrators to review and release quarantined messages.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: The platform should maintain audit logs of filtering decisions and administrator actions, integrate with the university identity system, and provide a dashboard for monitoring email security events.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The solution should be secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable for university-wide deployment.

functional.applicability_reason: Source-backed obligations; unspecified decisions remain open.

requirements.title: protect students, faculty, staff, and administrators from phishing, malicious attachments, spoofed messages, and suspicious links.
requirements.statement: The system shall protect students, faculty, staff, and administrators from phishing, malicious attachments, spoofed messages, and suspicious links.

acceptance_criteria.given: An email containing a phishing link is sent to a university user
acceptance_criteria.when: The email security gateway processes the incoming message
acceptance_criteria.then: The system detects the phishing content and blocks delivery
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the blocked message with phishing indicator

acceptance_criteria.given: An email with a malicious attachment is sent to a university user
acceptance_criteria.when: The email security gateway processes the incoming message
acceptance_criteria.then: The system identifies the malicious attachment and quarantines it
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the quarantined file with malware signature

acceptance_criteria.given: An email spoofed with a fake university domain is sent to a user
acceptance_criteria.when: The email security gateway processes the incoming message
acceptance_criteria.then: The system flags the sender as spoofed and alerts administrators
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the spoofed header and alert notification

acceptance_criteria.given: An email with a suspicious link is sent to a user
acceptance_criteria.when: The email security gateway processes the incoming message
acceptance_criteria.then: The system detects the suspicious URL and marks it for review
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the flagged link and user notification

unresolved_decisions: Thresholds for what constitutes a 'suspicious' link or attachment

requirements.title: inspect incoming and outgoing email traffic, detect suspicious messages, quarantine potentially harmful emails, generate security alerts, and allow authorized administrators to review and release quarantined messages.
requirements.statement: The system shall inspect incoming and outgoing email traffic, detect suspicious messages, quarantine potentially harmful emails, generate security alerts, and allow authorized administrators to review and release quarantined messages.

acceptance_criteria.given: An incoming email with malicious content is received by the gateway
acceptance_criteria.when: The system performs inspection on the message body and headers
acceptance_criteria.then: The system quarantines the message and generates a security alert
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of quarantine action and generated alert

acceptance_criteria.given: An outgoing email is sent from a university user to an external recipient
acceptance_criteria.when: The system inspects the content for malicious payloads or links
acceptance_criteria.then: The system detects suspicious content and blocks transmission
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of blocked outbound message with reason

acceptance_criteria.given: A quarantined email is identified by an administrator
acceptance_criteria.when: An authorized admin requests review and release of the message
acceptance_criteria.then: The system allows the administrator to view and approve or reject the message
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of admin interface response for quarantined email

acceptance_criteria.given: A suspicious message is detected during processing
acceptance_criteria.when: The system generates a security alert
acceptance_criteria.then: The alert is delivered to designated administrators via secure channel
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of alert delivery to admin console

unresolved_decisions: Authentication method for administrator access to quarantined messages

nonfunctional.applicability_reason: Source-backed obligations; unspecified decisions remain open.

requirements.title: The solution shall be secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable for university-wide deployment.
requirements.statement: The solution shall be secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable for university-wide deployment.

acceptance_criteria.given: A system administrator initiates a deployment request for university-wide use
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the deployment request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system returns a status indicating successful validation of security, reliability, scalability, and manageability criteria
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the system's response to deployment request with validated criteria

acceptance_criteria.given: A network operations team observes increasing load during peak hours
acceptance_criteria.when: The system handles traffic under sustained high-load conditions
acceptance_criteria.then: The system maintains service availability and performance without degradation
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of system performance metrics during peak load

acceptance_criteria.given: A new department requests integration with existing university services
acceptance_criteria.when: The system is configured to support new service connections
acceptance_criteria.then: The system enables configuration without requiring revalidation or manual intervention
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of configuration workflow and successful service integration

unresolved_decisions: Definition of 'manageable' in context of university-wide deployment
Thresholds for scalability under concurrent user load
Validation method for reliability during failure scenarios

security.applicability_reason: Source-backed obligations; unspecified decisions remain open.

requirements.title: The platform shall maintain audit logs of filtering decisions and administrator actions, integrate with the university identity system, and provide a dashboard for monitoring email security events.
requirements.statement: The platform shall maintain audit logs of filtering decisions and administrator actions, integrate with the university identity system, and provide a dashboard for monitoring email security events.

acceptance_criteria.given: An administrator performs a filtering action on an email message
acceptance_criteria.when: The system records the filtering decision and associated user action
acceptance_criteria.then: The audit log contains a record of the filtering decision and the administrator's identity and timestamp
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of the audit log entry

acceptance_criteria.given: An email security event occurs in the system
acceptance_criteria.when: The platform generates an alert for monitoring via its dashboard
acceptance_criteria.then: The dashboard displays the event with relevant metadata including source, severity, and timestamp
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of dashboard event display

acceptance_criteria.given: The university identity system is integrated with the platform
acceptance_criteria.when: An administrator logs in using their university credentials
acceptance_criteria.then: The platform authenticates the user and grants access based on role and permissions
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: Test capture of authentication and access grant

unresolved_decisions: Definition of 'filtering decision' in audit logs
Threshold for event severity in dashboard alerts
Authentication method used during integration with identity system

items.title: Log
items.detail: A collection of event records. This term does not itself require additional logging fields, events or access permissions.

items.title: Audit record
items.detail: A stored record of an event. Required event scope and retention are determined by the linked source, not this definition.
